_meta.description: Master sensor unit registry for PumpSmart Project

X_ACR_Mot.PV.notes: Very low mm/s values consistent with precision bearing mount

X_ACR_Mot.SV.notes: ISO 10816: broadband SCADA envelope — use relative multipliers only, NOT single-tone acceleration. High-load cluster mean=36.26 m/s2 (fault-adjacent)

X_ACR_Mot.TV.notes: Corroborating sensor only. Startup cluster shows HIGHER mean temp (39.6 degC) vs high_load (35.1 degC) — K-Means thermal run-in paradox. Temperature alone cannot distinguish operating mode.

X_ACR_Pmp.PV.notes: Very low mm/s values consistent with precision bearing mount

X_ACR_Pmp.SV.notes: ISO 10816: broadband SCADA envelope. Steady-state p97.5=55.3 m/s2 — wide normal range due to pressure pulsation coupling

X_ACR_Pmp.TV.notes: Corroborating sensor only. Not primary fault indicator.

X_Temp.SV.notes: Used as T_ambient proxy in M3 normalisation: DeltaT* = (T_bearing - T_Temp.SV_row) / (T_cluster_max - T_Temp.SV_row). Per-row, not fixed 20.0 degC.

X_Pres.SV.notes: Primary operating mode discriminator. Startup: ~0.62 bar (near-zero). Steady-state: ~35.8 bar. High-load: ~42.0 bar.

Barometer.notes: Environmental sensor. NOT used in K-Means clustering or M3 normalisation baselines.

Temperature.notes: Environmental sensor. NOT used in K-Means clustering. Used as T_ambient per-row in M3 temperature normalisation formula.
